finding: Apple documents per-connection proxy configurations and the matchDomains API surface. WebKit public source stores/serializes each supplied NW proxy configuration for its WebsiteDataStore. The reviewed sources do not specify that an empty match-domain list matches every WebKit request. Therefore V171 does not prove an all-host route and cannot be called a proxy fix without runtime evidence.

officialEvidence.supports: ProxyConfiguration APIs and matchDomains property exist; reviewed page does not state empty-list matching semantics.
Public C API for adding a match domain; no empty-list wildcard semantics stated in the rendered documentation.
Proxy configurations apply to connections in the session; the empty array means default system settings. This is distinct from an empty matchDomains list inside a configured proxy.
WebKit copies the supplied proxy configurations and serializes each config into WebsiteDataStore state; this code does not define empty match-domain selection.
